default: Reject unspecified transition; preserve current state and evidence
invariants: INFRA_LOCK implies no new local checker launch

observer_limit: If supervisor/host dies, this FSM cannot guarantee emitting a terminal event.

guards.termination_reconciled: Identity-bound evidence confirms prior checker termination AND admission reconciliation is complete; no PID-only, acknowledgement-only or restart-only unlock.
guards.no_unresolved_run: Admission bookkeeping reconciled, no unknown prior child.
guards.admitted: Only authorized identified local checker, no active/unresolved prior run, resource policy satisfied.
guards.launch_failed_no_child: Launch failed and absence of a created child is established; otherwise launch_outcome_unknown.
guards.launch_outcome_unknown: Launch outcome or identity/existence of possible child cannot be established.
guards.fresh_request: Explicit new local request, not automatic retry. Receipt status does not clear admission latch.

orthogonal_gate: INFRA_LOCK is an admission latch; writing a receipt or notifying cannot clear it. Transaction states do not overwrite this latch.

state_semantics.RUNNING: Owns the launch attempt or live child; launch failure must be classified explicitly.
state_semantics.INFRA_LOCK: Admission latch locked; receipt events may update receipt_status without admitting a new child.
